headline: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO
points: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, effective immediately, after a unanimous vote
Colette Kress, who had been interim CEO while also CFO, was thanked by the board
At the close the Nasdaq Composite was up about 6.9 percent and the Dow about 3.2 percent, after Friday's sell-off
Nvidia shares rose about 33 percent; the gains held and widened into the close, rather than fading from the pre-market jump of about 27 percent
